rows.meaning: embody; be a perfect example of
rows.traditional: A 係 B 嘅化身
rows.jyutping: A hai6 B ge3 faa3 san1
rows.note: Use this construction when a person or thing embodies a quality and is its perfect example.

example.english: To personify perseverance, look no further than my mum.
example.jyutping: aa3 maa1 hai6 gin1 ngai6 ge3 faa3 san1

rows.meaning: represent an abstract quality as a person
rows.note: Use this when an abstract idea is deliberately represented as a human character or persona, rather than embodied by a real person.

example.english: This fable uses a goddess holding scales to personify justice.
example.traditional: 呢套寓言將正義擬人化成一位手持天秤嘅女神。
example.jyutping: ni1 tou3 jyu6 jin4 zoeng1 zing3 ji6 ji5 jan4 faa3 sing4 jat1 wai6 sau2 ci4 tin1 cing3 ge3 neoi5 san4
